title: Subsidie
summary: Case type with assessment, award, advance and settlement; flow for the payment.
description: The generic subsidie case type (Awb titel 4.2) with its statuses, roles, the beschiktBedrag field and a published flow. Sets grantChain, the case type flag the case page's grant parts (interim reports, evidence, settlement, recovery) and their header actions gate on. Settling the grant (board DqSubsidie: Adopt) is the case type's primary button through `primaryAction`. Installed on request: POST /api/packages/subsidie/install, or occ dossiq:package:install subsidie. Converted by scripts/packages/seed-to-package.py from the parked subsidie entry in the old bezwaar seed.
